body: Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-20 18:43Z, a recurring slip). When assigning diagnosis of host state, state explicitly: "host API and repo files only; never open the live store (~/.termal/*.sqlite), read-only included". Today Sol-a7bb opened termal.sqlite in mode=ro to correlate a stale test-run row (w-6c8c268ef95c), while the store's writer was already stalling (w-1fcaa9b93d12). Coder was told the same earlier. Corrections then go on the item, recording which fields came from the store. File-size metadata (stat only) is acceptable.
